sources.details: For [1,2,3], mean2, population variance(1+0+1)/3=2/3, RMS²=(1+4+9)/3=14/3. With eps1e-5 both 4dp outputs agree with displayed vectors. Loss is nll_sum/valid next-token count, not unweighted mean over stories or eight generated examples.

claims.statement: LayerNorm subtracts feature mean and divides by sqrt(population variance+eps); RMSNorm divides by sqrt(mean square+eps) without centering, so the rules retain different information.
claims.scope: Per-position feature vector; affine parameters fixed to gamma1/beta0 in the demonstrated rule. Preservation means retaining the common-mean component, not invariance to additive shifts.

evidence.supports: Original definitions and removal of centering.
Epsilon-stabilized denominator and final normalized dimensions.
All equal positive inputs center to0 but RMS-normalize to approximately1.

claims.statement: Standard LayerNorm can learn per-feature gamma and beta; the common gamma-only RMSNorm form lacks beta.
claims.scope: Describes standard/default module forms; paper's downstream neuron bias outside normalization is not asserted absent throughout every network.

evidence.supports: Per-feature affine LN weight/bias and gamma-only RMSNorm implementation.
Repository RMSNorm has learned weight and no bias.
